title: Balanced Retry Trees for Haskell-Based Notification Queues: Complexity, Invariants, and Fan-Out Dynamics
topic: Design a Notification System: Queues, Retries and Fan-out
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a lightweight, purely functional notification engine that couples a bounded retry policy with a fan-out mechanism implemented as a height-balanced binary search tree over per-subscriber pending queues. The design guarantees that each subscriber's pending list remains strictly height-balanced and key-ordered after every delivery attempt, yielding $O(\log N)$ amortized complexity for insertion, deletion, and lookup, where $N$ is the number of pending notifications. Formal invariants are proven using structural induction over the tree representation, and the entire system is verified by automated AST inspection on an AMD EPYC 9V45 platform. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/haskell-functional-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261116_130227_design_a_notification_system}.
